subject: Custody transcript & rotation replay for AuroraHealth POC
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: security@aurorahealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: custody transcript + rotation replay for POC

Marcus —

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. For our internal compliance review we need two items before the POC kickoff: a custody transcript that shows which tenant keys were used for stored patient-mock data, and a short "rotation replay" that demonstrates a key rotation (including wrapped-key rebind) and the resulting access matrix snapshot.

Our SOC team would prefer a short CSV extract and a short narrative (1 page) that explains how rotations are expressed in your audit logs. Can you confirm you can produce a sanitized example (no real patient data) and a timeline for delivery? We plan to present to procurement next Wednesday.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Security Lead, Aurora Health
liam.oconnor@aurorahealth.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: custody transcript + rotation replay for POC

Hi Liam —

We can do that. Proposed plan: 
- We will produce a sanitized CSV extract (rotation-log-snippet) showing key identifiers (redacted), timestamps, actor IDs (service-account@redwood replaced with tokenized IDs), and action types (generate, rotate, wrap/unwrap, revoke).
- We will include a 1-page narrative describing how rotations are represented in the audit trail and how wrapped-key rebinds are logged when BYOK is used.
- We'll include a short HSM attestation summary that states the HSM model, firmware baseline, and attested seal time.

Timeline: initial artifacts by Fri, 28 Nov (EOD). If procurement needs them earlier for the Wed review, we can prioritize a minimal set by Tue morning — let me know.

Two clarifications before we sanitize: 
1) Which tenant ID should we use for the sanitized CSV label? (Real tenant ID vs pseudo label)
2) Do you want the replay to show a full rotation (old key -> new key) including any client-side rewrap steps, or just the server-side key material handling?

I'll loop in Irene (ops) to gather the logs and Karthik for the HSM attestation language.

Best,
Marcus
Head of Security Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:41:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: rotation logs + attestation draft for Aurora (sanitized)

Marcus / Karthik —

Attaching the sanitized artifacts we discussed. Notes inline: 
- rotation-log-snippet-20261128.csv: contains pseudo-tenant labels (aurora-poc-001) and tokenized key IDs (k_xxx). Timestamps in UTC.
- kv-cache-prefix-samples.txt: shows the prefixing scheme we use for tenant isolation and demonstrates KV cache invalidation on rotation.
- hsm-attestation-summary-20261128.pdf: short summary from the HSM provider; does not include private blobs.

I redacted real tenant GUIDs and replaced actor emails with internal role tokens. The CSV includes a simple "rebind_step" column where we record whether a client-side rewrap was required. Sample rows: 

"timestamp,tenant_label,action,key_id,actor,rebind_step"
"2026-11-12T02:14:23Z,aurora-poc-001,rotate,k_xxx12,service-token-7,false"
"2026-11-12T02:14:30Z,aurora-poc-001,wrap,k_xxx13,client-rewrap-42,true"

Ben — FYI on procurement questions; can you confirm the format meets our export policy (no raw secrets included)?

Irene
Director, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rotation-log-snippet-20261128.csv (CSV, 4 KB); hsm-attestation-summary-20261128.pdf (PDF, 120 KB); kv-cache-prefix-samples.txt (TXT, 1 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aurorahealth.com>, procurement@aurorahealth.com
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: custody transcript + rotation replay for POC — artifacts attached

Liam / Aurora procurement —

Attached are the sanitized artifacts and a short narrative describing the log semantics and rotation replay steps. High level summary: 
- The CSV shows redacted key IDs, rotation events, and whether a client-side rewrap occurred.
- The KV prefix sample explains how we segregate tenant caches and how those keys are invalidated/evicted post-rotation.
- HSM attestation summary confirms the module (VendorX HSM v3) and the attestation timestamp corresponding to the sample.

Requested next steps: 
1) Confirm the sanitized format is acceptable for your SOC review.
2) If acceptable, procurement: confirm whether you need the DocuSign NDA amendment (we can supply an exhibit to the SOW for BYOK handling).
3) If you need a live demo of the rotation replay, we can schedule a 30-minute session next Tue (Nov 30) morning PST.

If you want further drilldowns we can produce a larger log slice (requires 48 hours prep to ensure redaction and legal approval).

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Security Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rotation-log-snippet-20261128.csv; hsm-attestation-summary-20261128.pdf; kv-cache-prefix-samples.txt
